measures.name: Comprehensive Diabetes Care: HbA1c Poor Control (>9.0%)
measures.target_population: Patients 18-75 years of age with active Type 1 or Type 2 Diabetes
measures.impact: Lowers CMS Star Rating for Medicare Advantage plans; indicates elevated risk for microvascular complications
measures.recommended_action: Schedule urgent provider reconciliation. Order repeated glycemic testing. Enroll member in diabetic disease management program and remote blood glucose monitoring.

measures.name: Comprehensive Diabetes Care: Annual Retinal Eye Exam
measures.impact: CMS Star Rating Core Measure; prevents preventable diabetic blindness
measures.recommended_action: Issue electronic referral for dilated retinal photography or ophthalmology evaluation.

measures.name: Comprehensive Diabetes Care: Kidney Health Evaluation (KED)
measures.impact: Early detection of Diabetic Nephropathy; critical for initiating SGLT2i or ACEi therapy
measures.recommended_action: Order annual Urine Albumin-to-Creatinine Ratio (uACR) and serum creatinine/eGFR panel.

measures.name: Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes (SUPD)
measures.target_population: Diabetic patients aged 40-75 without ASCVD contraindications
measures.impact: Triple-weighted CMS Star Measure; reduces major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE)
measures.recommended_action: Initiate moderate-to-high intensity statin therapy (e.g. Atorvastatin 20-40mg daily).
